ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: A is a multi-turn coil, connected with a switch and a sliding rheostat and then connected to the AC power supply between M and N. B is a closed multi-turn coil connected with a small bulb. Which of the following statements about the small bulb lighting is correct (　　)
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Multi-Physics open-ended question 1
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: A is a multi-turn coil, connected with a switch and a sliding rheostat and then connected to the AC power supply between M and N. B is a closed multi-turn coil connected with a small bulb. After the switch is closed, is it possible for the small bulb to light up?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: A is a multi-turn coil, connected with a switch and a sliding rheostat and then connected to the AC power supply between M and N. B is a closed multi-turn coil connected with a small bulb. After the switch is closed, is it possible for the small bulb to light up?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: the left side of the figure is marked with the two terminals M and N, and there is an AC power supply symbol “~” in the middle. The circuit between M and N is connected by wires to a switch, a sliding rheostat, and a multi-turn coil marked A at the lower right. At the upper right there is a multi-turn coil marked B, and a small bulb is connected in series in B's circuit; B and A are placed close to each other, but the two are not directly connected by wires. Reasoning: after the switch is closed, coil A is connected to the AC power supply between M and N, and there is alternating current in A. The alternating current will produce an alternating magnetic field around A. Since coil B is close to A, the magnetic flux passing through coil B may change with time. According to the law of electromagnetic induction, an induced current will be produced in this closed circuit B. The small bulb is connected in series in the B circuit, so if the induced current is large enough, the small bulb may light up. Conclusion: the small bulb may light up.
